plan.text: Play D3. If able, South should take West’s DQ with DK, keeping DA for a later trick. Then cash HA, HK, DA and SA, and use CA, CK and CQ to establish the remaining clubs. The eight-card club suit should provide the extra tricks needed for 3NT; reassess if the club break or defense changes the count.
